title: An invariance screen for a bridging assumption, scored as a classifier
question: Does instability across observed trials predict failure of a bridge used in a gap with no data, and does a screen on marginal effects fire under a valid bridge through non-collapsibility?
design: K trials with differing covariate laws and a gap environment; Cochran's Q screen with abstention on marginal, conditional and standardized log odds ratios; valid bridge, drift visible in the trials, and drift confined to the gap; 20 cells and 3 controls, 1000 replicates each.
